material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Jan 2, 2024 to Dec 2, 2024 (+184%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−5.1% to −22%), with the 50-week average and the 200-week average in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−44%); a close over the wave-1 high (+58%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
